market_summary: Across all six assets during the London session, price action is heavily compressed inside session Value Areas around respective Points of Control (POCs) and mean baselines. FX majors EURUSD and GBPUSD display tight coiling around VWAP with CVD divergence capping upside momentum. Precious metals XAUUSD and XAGUSD are pinned between local S/R levels and their session POCs below VWAP. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish beneath declining EMA50 baselines but are trapped in mid-channel consolidation without yellow RVOL expansion volume. With all instruments lacking high-conviction directional breakouts or liquidity sweeps, disciplined patience mandates HOLD across the entire portfolio ahead of New York liquidity.
